title: Cleopatra Is Closer to the Moon Landing Than the Pyramids
description:
Cleopatra was born closer in time to the 1969 Moon landing than to the building of the Great Pyramid.
Follow MarketOpsTips for a surprising fact every evening.

#facts #history #shorts

beats.say: Cleopatra lived closer to the Moon landing than to the Great Pyramid.
The Great Pyramid was built around 2560 BC.
Cleopatra was born in 69 BC. That's about 2,500 years later.
To her, the pyramids were already ancient history.
Then in 1969, humans landed on the Moon.
That's only about 2,000 years after Cleopatra.
Time is bigger than it looks. Which date surprised you most?
